text:
Lena: Random idea 12:30 office erg relay + desk mobility pop-up? 3-person teams, 500m rows each on the erg in the lounge, quick mobility circuit between legs. Low pressure, silly medals. :rowing_man: :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Omar: Love it. Can we make a "no shoes on carpet" rule? My socks have opinions.
Theo: I can bring a cheap foam roller + lacrosse ball for the mobility station. Suggest mobility mini-circuit: 3 moves x 30s.
Jas: I'm down if we promise not to include burpees. Also: prize = one free smoothie from cafe. ;)
Lena: Plan: 12:30 start, teams of 3, each person 500m on erg, between row legs do 30s each of: hip CARs, thoracic rotations, ankle flossing. Repeat until done. Quick scoreboard on whiteboard.
Omar: Can we have a lightweight handicap: slower rowers get 20s head start? Keeps it fun. :grin:
Theo: Quick mobility guide (copy/paste for the whiteboard): ```Hip CARs 30s each side
T-spine openers 30s
Ankle pumps/floss 30s``` Easy to demo.
Jas: WellnessBot: created event "Erg Relay + Mobility Pop-up" 12:25 reminder posted. :bell:
WellnessBot: FYI - lounge has two ergs. If more teams sign up we'll stagger heats at 12:30 and 12:50. (auto)
Lena: OK who's in? Reply with team name or solo and we'll pair people.
Omar: Team "Sock Puppets" (me, Theo, Lena).
Theo: Team "Foam & Flow" (flip if needed).
Jas: Solo sign-up, happy to shotgun-smoothie the winners. :coffee:
Lena: Sweet. I'll make a tiny bracket and print sticky bibs. See you at 12:25 for warmups! :muscle:
